title: Streaks App Chain Break Recovery Time
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:streak habit_name=* chain_break_epoch=* chain_resume_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((chain_resume_epoch-chain_break_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by habit_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures chain-break recovery time by habit for Streaks recovery.
value: Lag tracking shows which habit create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside Streaks recovery.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `chain-break recovery time` on `lifeos:streak` events and aggregate them by `habit_name`.
visualization: Table of habit with average and worst chain-break recovery time.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how long things take for each habit so you can see where Streaks recovery slows down.
